title: 关羽斩华雄传记
prompts:
Integrated art-direction edit, landscape 1536x1024. IMAGE 1 is the CURRENT STORY and scene/pose reference. IMAGE 2 is the FROZEN SILVER CARD and must directly determine Guan Yu's mature face, green war robes, white lining, complete dark SILVER-scale armor with controlled gold decorative trims, jade-accented green pole and recognizable ornate broad crescent glaive. Do not change Image 2 itself. Do not replace with all-gold armor or a thin tapered spear/sword.
Reorganize the overall visual hierarchy of Image 1 in ONE coherent composition: GUAN YU + HIS GLAIVE + DRAGON are the sole dominant sharp high-attention foreground. Move Guan Yu and dragon slightly DOWN from the top so Guan Yu's complete head/face and torso become the central visual focus rather than crowded in upper-left. Preserve his dynamic airborne attacking pose, now centered around left-middle and larger relative to supporting figures. His face, eyes and determined combat expression are directly locked on Hua Xiong below-right, mature calm decisiveness, no distorted facial features. Main robe/armor designs must faithfully use Image 2's silver-rank outfit and face. Strong diagonal down-right green blade force, ONE rigid perfectly straight pole through both hands and socket, ONE solid full-bellied crescent blade, substantial middle/front metal belly, distinct convex edge and concave back/upturned point. Preserve readable metal rather than hiding it in glow.
The dragon has a THICK powerful head and neck like Image 2, PURE EMERALD GREEN not cyan/blue. A portion of its massive torso emerges and disappears naturally in clouds behind Guan Yu, with continuous implied anatomy and one head; fewer coils, NO full snake-ring loop, no skinny snake tail circling the canvas, no forced full-body display. Dragon echoes Guan Yu's blade direction. Bold designed light/dark masses, not random particles.
REDUCE Hua Xiong's size/area, contrast, texture and sharpness relative to Guan Yu, keeping him as a readable lower-right opponent under pressure. Preserve the SUCCESSFULLY REDRAWN simple front-side 3/4 torso and the CORRECT coherent arm structure from Image 1: near elbow beside ribs, near forearm rises to grip near chest, far arm foreshortened forward/up, two hands grip ONE diagonal saber handle in front of his torso; NO old overhead double-biceps pose, no backwards twisted torso. Shoulder, elbow, wrist and hand chains must remain readable at shared perspective, do NOT blur anatomy to hide problems. He remains rough massive western-warrior with loose hair, dark/red armor, single heavy saber and braced lower stance. Adjust his position and saber so it actually contacts Guan Yu's physical crescent edge at one convincing load-bearing point, not a spark across a gap.
Reduce the background fortress/flags/three wine-waiting men in area, contrast, sharpness and busy detail, softly atmospheric and subordinate but still readable narrative. Cao Cao's approved navy military armor, seated raised wine cup and sword, and Liu Bei's approved green commander's armor and face are FROZEN in design, can shrink together. Zhang Fei is dark Shu-green armor, rough broad leopard face, thick eyebrows and round fierce eyes. Three small men only, do not spotlight them. Grounded Chinese fortress with clear plaque '汜水關' and alliance banners, NOT floating islands. Keep story itself, no montage, no UI/frame/additional text. Visually Guan Yu > glaive/dragon > opponent > all setting and supporting cast.

Correct this candidate in one precise edit and render at requested HIGH RESOLUTION 3072x2048 landscape if supported, with real clear facial/armor/weapon structure rather than artificial sharpening. Preserve the improved dominant Guan Yu/dragon/crescent composition and the smaller Hua Xiong.
MANDATORY FIX: Guan Yu currently has THREE hands on the shaft. Remove the EXTRA MIDDLE HAND at approximately x490,y220 in this 1536x1024 input, along with its extra forearm/sleeve; restore uninterrupted straight shaft there and coherent robe behind it. Retain ONLY the top-left hand at (375,113) belonging to the raised arm AND the lower-right hand at (700,407) belonging to the forward arm. Exactly TWO ARMS, TWO HANDS, trace each from its own shoulder through elbow/wrist; one rigid straight pole, no remnants of third hand. Do NOT remove either correct end hand. His face, green robes/silver-scale armor and full crescent weapon stay high-detail.
MANDATORY FIX: Lower-left scene currently has FOUR observers. Remove the extra FOURTH man seated farthest right of that little group around (235,785). Preserve ONLY Zhang Fei at far left, seated blue-armored Cao Cao holding raised steaming wine cup, and standing green-armored Liu Bei behind him. Three observers only. Do not change Cao Cao/Liu Bei faces/costumes/poses. Zhang Fei dark green armor fierce thick brows broad rough face.
Keep Hua Xiong's correct simple front-side three-quarter torso, near elbow beside ribs, far forearm foreshortened forward, exactly two hands gripping single heavy saber across chest, one actual physical metal contact with Guan Yu's crescent. Maintain anatomy visibility; no blurred concealment.
Give all secondary subjects/background (Hua Xiong, fortress, tiny wine observers and flags) lower contrast, lower texture density and softer atmospheric edges than Guan Yu, while keeping hand/arm/weapon construction readable. Do not blur entire image. Dominant crisp Guan Yu face, eyes, silver armor scales, rigid weapon and green dragon. Preserve green dragon thick head and partially visible massive body without adding loops.
Gate plaque text 汜水關. No UI/frame/other text. Final output 3072x2048 or highest native supported landscape resolution.

qa.hierarchy: Guan Yu and glaive now much larger, face and torso lowered toward center; green thick dragon major second focus. Opponent and wine observers smaller.
qa.hands: Intermediate introduced third Guan Yu hand, explicitly removed in final edit. Final personally inspected crop shows exactly two Guan Yu grips with continuous straight shaft between them; no extra middle hand. Hua Xiong retains near bent elbow by ribs and far arm foreshortening, two hands on diagonal saber.
qa.observers: Exactly three in final: green Zhang Fei left, blue Cao Cao raised wine cup, green Liu Bei behind. Intermediate extra fourth man removed.
qa.contact: One physical metal edge contact near (1065,696); bright spark there, saber blade shape remains visible.
caveats: Built-in returned 1536x1024 despite explicit 3072x2048 request; no fake upscaling used.
Fortress plaque first character still incorrect, parent overlay required.
Dragon remains substantial coiled torso rather than only cloud-partial; foreground/background contrast improved but background still fairly detailed.
